tools.name: get_cds_services
tools.description: CDS Hooks service discovery. Returns the list of available CDS Hook services for EHR integration (patient-view, order-select).

tools.name: handle_patient_view
tools.description: CDS Hooks patient-view handler. Triggered when a provider opens a patient chart. Retrieves patient conditions from HealthLake and returns informational cards about conditions that may require prior authorization.

tools.name: handle_order_select
tools.description: CDS Hooks order-select handler. Triggered when a provider selects an order. Evaluates whether prior authorization is required based on patient coverage, the ordered procedure/medication, and payor-specific rules. Returns CDS cards with prior auth determination.

context.description: CDS Hooks context containing patientId and draftOrders

draftOrders.description: FHIR Bundle of draft orders (MedicationRequest, ServiceRequest)
